- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10549-10554 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The cached GraphQL `head.sha` handling can emit a present-but-empty SHA, which the retrigger and blank-`head_branch` matching logic may treat as a valid match.
  WHY: That creates a race where an empty-commit push can proceed while an in-flight `workflow_dispatch` review run is already queued on the same SHA.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1410-1410,1685-1696 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The first-non-empty-line refusal capture can still be stale or empty across retry-loop iterations, so later output may inherit the previous attempt’s value.
  WHY: That can misclassify a later structured success summary as a refusal, aborting retries and leaving `editor_refused.flag` set even though the output validated.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1407-1414 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The refusal short-circuit runs only after the header-validation chain, so partial editor output can skip the refusal sentinel path.
  WHY: A silent refusal would fall through as a generic noop instead of setting `EDITOR_NOOP_REFUSAL=true`, suppressing the specific rerun-after-cache-expiry warning.
